    • Method Detail

      • loadAllReferencesTo

        void loadAllReferencesTo(java.util.Collection<org.modelio.vcore.smkernel.SmObjectImpl> objs)
        Deprecated. 
        Load all model objects that reference the given ones, with the dependency used to reference them.

        Must load navigable and non navigable dependencies. To be used to navigate many non navigable dependencies at once, avoiding plenty database queries.

        After having called this method, call SmDependency.getValueAsCollection(org.modelio.vcore.smkernel.ISmObjectData) to get the loaded values instead of calling standard getters.

        Parameters:
        objs - all model objects whose all dependencies must be loaded.

      • getDepValue

                                                                          org.modelio.vcore.smkernel.meta.SmDependency dep)
        Deprecated. 
        Get the loaded dependency value.

        loadAllReferencesTo(Collection) must have been called with the object passed in the collection before, or undefined behavior will occur.

        Parameters:
        object - the model object data.
        Returns:
        the dependency content.
